sources.snippet: Whisper Tiny is a 39M-parameter ASR model optimized for on-device use through compression, distillation, and fine-tuning for efficient multilingual speech recognition.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning Whisper-Tiny on MInds14 (English) - GitHub
sources.snippet: What it does Whisper-tiny is a general-purpose speech recognition model. This project fine-tunes it specifically on MInds14's English intent-classification audio clips, freezing most of the encoder so only the decoder's cross-attention layers and the rest of the decoder adapt to the new data.
